metadata.scenario: A patient argues over an unexpected charge on their recent medical bill, claiming it was not agreed upon beforehand. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, how can I help you today? Hi, this is Karen Lewis. I'm calling about a billing issue related to my husband's recent care. I'm sorry to hear that, Karen. What specific issue are you experiencing? We received a bill that includes a charge for IV therapy, but we never agreed to that service. I understand your concern. Let me pull up your account to review the details. Can you please hold for a moment? Sure, take your time. Thank you for your patience, Karen. I see that there was a charge for IV Therapy Administration on your husband's bill. It was billed due to a recommendation from the nurse during the last visit. But that’s not what we discussed! I specifically asked for only post-operative care. This charge is unexpected. I completely understand, and I apologize for any confusion. Let me clarify this for you. Sometimes additional services are recommended based on changing medical needs, but we should have communicated that clearly to you beforehand. Yes, I would have appreciated that. I don’t want to pay for services that weren't approved. Absolutely, I will review this charge and see if we can adjust it for you. Thank you. That would help a lot. I will also make a note to improve our communication about any additional services in the future. In the meantime, would you be interested in discussing our Post-Surgery Recovery Care services? I’m not sure. I just want to resolve the billing issue first. Totally understandable. Let me take care of that first, and I’ll follow up with you. Can I get your best contact number to reach you once I have more information on the billing? Yes, it’s +13165552147, the same as my calling number. Great, I’ll follow up with you by the end of the day tomorrow. Thank you, I appreciate it. You’re welcome, Karen! I’ll make sure to resolve this promptly. If you have any other questions, feel free to reach out. Will do. Looking forward to your call. Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health. Have a great day! You too!
